packageRules.description: Merge non-major updates with GitHub's auto-merge, which waits for the CI checks the master ruleset requires.
Require dashboard approval before opening major upgrade PRs.

All Tombi crates come from one commit of the kjanat/tombi fork (see UPSTREAM.md), so update them together in one pull request. Merging it triggers an irreversible release (release.yml), so it is never automerged. Renovate names a Cargo git dependency by its git URL, not its crate name.
